name: Maiden Halo
source:
Noumi Hasegawa is a 13-years-old boy who wants to become a pianist. One night, he sees a ray of light floating in the sky. This marks his encounter with a mysterious girl called Eon. She starts living with him, and together they discover the true magic of the city they live in...

[translated and edited from [url=http://sp.v-motto.jp/pc/appli/maiden/index.php]official website[/url]]

This was the second kinetic novel released by Visual Art's, after "Planetarian".
translation:
长谷川努美是一个13岁的男孩，他想成为一名钢琴家。一天晚上，他看到天空中飘浮着一道光芒。这标志着他遇到了一位名叫埃恩的神秘女孩。她开始和他住在一起，他们一起发现了他们所居住的城市的真正魔力……

[翻译和编辑自[url=http://sp.v-motto.jp/pc/appli/maiden/index.php]官方网站[/url]]

这是继《行星人》之后，视觉艺术发行的第二部动态小说。
